# BASIS

> BASIS (Build AI Services In Sovereign infrastructure) runs the platform side of generative AI
> services on Kubernetes clusters a team owns: RAG databases, caches, model gateways and the wiring
> between them, for any model (hosted or self-hosted). Everything is a namespaced Kubernetes
> resource on the control plane, in a Project's namespace; the platform runs it in the Project's
> locations (clusters). Validate with `kubectl apply --dry-run=server`; refusals say what to fix.

## Rules

- Create everything in a Project's namespace (`kubectl get projects`). Workloads never run on the
  control plane.
- Names: lowercase letters, digits and "-", starting with a letter; GenAIStack max 28 characters,
  the others max 40.
- Provider API keys go in a Secret in the Project first; reference them, never inline them.
- What a GenAIStack composes (label `ai.cndev.nl/genaistack`) only changes through the stack.
- Switch a stack between sites with `spec.recovery.activeSite`; never edit its database directly.
- Prefer a GenAIStack for an AI service; use the building blocks for anything a stack doesn't cover.

## APIs

- GenAIStack (`ai.cndev.nl/v1alpha1`, short `gstack`): RAG database + cache + model gateway +
  wiring. Apps mount Secret `<name>-connection` (in the location): DATABASE_URL, VALKEY_URL,
  OPENAI_BASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, SITE, ACTIVE.
  spec: retrieval {size, instances=3, storageSize=20Gi, backup, extensions=[vector]};
  cache {enabled=true, mode=semantic|exact, memory=1Gi, cpu, evictionPolicy};
  gateway {enabled=true, models[], replicas=2, ref (shared ModelGateway), client};
  recovery {enabled=false, activeSite=protected|recovery, promotion=Switchover|Failover,
  cacheMemory=512Mi, gatewayReplicas=1}; deletionProtection=true.
- ModelGateway (`ai.cndev.nl/v1alpha1`, short `mgw`): OpenAI-compatible endpoint
  `http://<name>.<project>.svc/v1` to hosted and self-hosted models, a key per client in Secret
  `<name>-keys`. spec: models[] {name, endpoint, schema=OpenAI|Anthropic, upstreamModel,
  apiKeySecretRef {name, key=apiKey}}; clients[] {name} = [apps]; replicas=2;
  recovery {enabled, replicas=1}; activeSite.
- PostgresCluster (`postgres.cndev.nl/v1alpha1`, short `pgc`): highly available PostgreSQL on
  CloudNativePG. spec: size (catalog), instances, storage {size}, profile (vector = pgvector,
  VectorChord, pg_search; needs postgresVersion 18), postgresVersion, database {extensions},
  backup {enabled}, geoReplication {enabled, primarySite, promotion}, pooler, roles.
- ValkeyCache (`cache.cndev.nl/v1alpha1`, short `vcache`): exact or semantic cache.
  spec: mode=exact|semantic (fixed), site=protected|recovery (fixed), shards=1, replicas=1,
  resources {cpu, memory}, maxMemoryPercent=75, evictionPolicy=allkeys-lru.
- Project (`platform.cndev.nl/v1alpha1`, cluster-scoped): a team's namespace, its locations
  {protected, recovery}, access, quota, Prometheus and Grafana. Platform admins create them.
- Location (`platform.cndev.nl/v1alpha1`, cluster-scoped): a cluster workloads run in. Admins only.
